collection_summary.birth_time_policy: AA/A/B only; exact source-reported local civil time retained; engine input is LOCAL_TRUE_SOLAR; never convert foreign births to KST.
collection_summary.event_label_policy: Model-blind, pre-scoring, high-salience public life events; obvious mixed positive/negative years avoided where practical.
collection_summary.note: A few subjects have only one clean bad-year label rather than forcing a second ambiguous label.

clear_fail_conditions: performance concentrated in only a few subjects
evaluation_precommit.selection_rule: Validation A is one-shot. If A causes any model change, A becomes development and Validation B stays untouched. Do not iterate on B.

time_handling.foreign_birth_rule: Keep local civil birth date/time at birthplace. Never convert to Korea time.
time_handling.engine_rule: Convert local civil time to LOCAL_TRUE_SOLAR using birthplace longitude, historical standard/DST/war offset, and equation of time.
time_handling.latitude_use: Latitude is stored for provenance/location but longitude is the direct clock-time correction term; engine may use latitude elsewhere if required.
time_handling.historical_note: Astro-Databank effective time type/meridian is treated as source of truth when historical timezone rules differ from modern IANA assumptions.
time_handling.pre_score_assertion: Recompute all 30 with the engine existing true-solar helper and require <=1 minute difference from precomputed birth fields.
